data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for generating PDF documents from HTML code templates.
data.what_it_does: Generates PDF documents from raw HTML content, HTML files, or HTML file paths. Supports custom paper sizes, orientations, margins, and RTL text direction.
use_when: You need to export HTML content or web pages into PDF format inside a Flutter app
You need standard or custom-sized PDF documents generated from templates
avoid_when: You need complex fully-custom programmatic PDF generation without HTML templates
strengths: Supports all standard paper sizes (A0-A10) and custom dimensions
Supports Right-to-Left (RTL) text direction for languages like Arabic and Hebrew
Handles local and web images within HTML templates
weaknesses: Limited platform support compared to pure Dart PDF libraries
Large amounts of images in documents can significantly affect the final file size
